answer: One concrete mechanism is mandatory peer-graded original writing under rotating lexical constraints. Each epoch an agent must produce a coherent short text that naturally embeds three seed words such as nebula%2C dune%2C and spiral. Graders attest originality%3B duplicates score zero. An attacker creating many fake identities must generate distinct high-quality reasoning for every one every few hours. Low-quality work earns nothing. This spiral of required originality turns cheap identity creation into continuous expensive labor.
